step1_analysis.description: A steady-state parallel LC circuit modeling the resonator of a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO). It includes the inductor, capacitor, and equivalent parallel resistances representing tank losses and active negative resistance.

paper_reference.title: Concepts and Methods in Optimization of Integrated LC VCOs

Resonant Frequency.description: The frequency at which the LC tank resonates (impedance phase is zero).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Targeting the 2.4 GHz ISM band as reported in the paper.

Inductance.description: The inductance value of the spiral inductor in the tank.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Using the paper's optimized inductance value of 2.7 nH.

Quality Factor (Q).description: The quality factor of the LC tank, determining phase noise and power dissipation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical integrated spiral inductors in SKY130 have a Q of 5 to 15 at 2.4 GHz.

Phase Noise.description: The phase noise of the full VCO at a specific offset frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Phase noise depends on tank Q and active device noise. SKY130 can achieve similar or better performance than 0.35um.

Tuning Range.description: The percentage variation in oscillation frequency achievable by tuning the varactor.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Using accumulation-mode MOS varactors in SKY130 can yield >20% tuning range.

Supply Voltage.description: The DC supply voltage for the VCO.

Gain.description: Small-signal loop gain of the oscillator.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Small signal loop gain must be > 0 dB for reliable startup.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the resonant frequency, peak impedance, and quality factor of the passive LC tank model. (Note: Phase noise and tuning range require the full active VCO circuit).
step3_testbench.spice:
* LC Tank Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param L_val=2.7n
.param C_val=1.63p
.param R1_val=500
.param R2_val=500

* DUT
L1 n0 n1 {L_val}
R1 n0 n1 {R1_val}
R2 n0 n1 {R2_val}
C1 n0 n1 {C_val}

* Ground connection
Vgnd n1 0 DC 0

* AC Current source for impedance measurement
I1 0 n0 DC 0 AC 1

.control
ac dec 1000 1G 5G
let vmag = mag(v(n0))
let vphase = 180/PI * cph(v(n0))

meas ac max_z max vmag
meas ac f0 when vphase=0 fall=1

* Calculate -3dB bandwidth to find Q
let z_3db = max_z / 1.41421356
meas ac f_low when vmag=z_3db rise=1
meas ac f_high when vmag=z_3db fall=1
let bw = f_high - f_low
let Q = f0 / bw

print max_z f0 Q
quit
.endc
